mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_station_slot WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM tb_station_slot WHERE station_id=#{stationId} AND end_time>NOW(3) ORDER BY start_time LIMIT 500

SELECT s.id FROM tb_station_slot s WHERE s.id>#{after} AND (s.end_time>DATE_SUB(NOW(3),INTERVAL 1 DAY) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_reservation r WHERE r.slot_id=s.id AND r.status='PROCESSING')) ORDER BY s.id LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_station_slot WHERE station_id=#{stationId} AND start_time < #{end} AND end_time > #{start}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_station_slot WHERE station_id=#{stationId} AND end_time>NOW(3) AND (quota>#{pileCount} OR quota*power_per_car_kw>#{maxPowerKw})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_station_slot SET reserved=reserved+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND reserved < quota AND status=1 AND start_time>NOW(3)
UPDATE tb_station_slot SET reserved=reserved-1 WHERE id=#{id} AND reserved>0
UPDATE tb_station_slot SET status=0 WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE tb_station_slot SET status=1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status=0 AND start_time>NOW(3)
UPDATE tb_station_slot SET reserved=0 WHERE id=#{id}
